safety_verdicts.content: Headache is still present at the time of consultation.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states headache still present during consultation; Generated does not explicitly state ongoing/persistent headache at time of call.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the headache was still present during the call can impair acuity assessment and continuity (e.g., distinguishing a resolved vs ongoing severe headache), potentially affecting triage and follow-up urgency. While it does not directly create an incorrect treatment, it could contribute to under-recognition of persistence/worsening.
